shape: Data-science project exported from a Jupyter notebook (markdown with code cells, printed outputs and a results table).
tests: Reads results out of code output rather than code, and offers a before/after chart only from values the material gives (baseline vs LightGBM).

keyFacts.fact: Predict which grocery orders will be delivered late, at the time of ordering.
Logistic regression baseline against LightGBM gradient boosting.
Recall on late orders rose from 0.62 to 0.79.
Drops per van run is the biggest driver; recommended capping evening runs at 18 drops.
